ruleDefinitions.name: Get-ADUser Enumeration Using UserAccountControl Flags
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects AS-REP roasting is an attack that is often-overlooked. It is not very common as you have to explicitly set accounts that do not require pre-authentication. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-ADUser.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Filter.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*useraccountcontrol.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-band.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*4194304.*"))
